answer: Fresh tasks stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits, draws a task from the onyx board, and tends a vine row. Its quill-signed proof lists task ID, fresh readings; the auditor replays the onyx board: reused task, copied proof, or stale reading burns the bond; a forgery triggers a vine-row re-audit exposing a rented-task ring. At 36+7(k-1), 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500, lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once, keeping the bond.
